ideas.pitch: An AI-powered commute optimization platform for students and residents in Hamilton that predicts HSR bus delays and dynamically suggests multi-modal walking and cycling alternatives.
ideas.title: HamiltonTransitPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves by targeting the daily pain of navigating Hamilton public transit during winter months.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile app for McMaster University campus sustainability that instantly classifies food waste and packaging, routing compostable items to local community gardens.
ideas.title: MacCampusWasteAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides clear measurable impact with concrete environmental benefits for the local campus ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered volunteer matching platform that pairs lonely seniors in Hamilton with McMaster health science student volunteers for wellness checks.
ideas.title: SteelCityCare
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets local social good and community needs, aligning well with judge values for regional impact.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local peer study group matchmaking app for DeltaHacks participants that forms optimal hackathon teams based on complementary skill sets and project interests.
ideas.title: DeltaStudyPeer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and hackers feel immediately in the room by helping solo participants form balanced teams.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting dashboard tracking real-time energy consumption across McMaster campus buildings, predicting peak load hours to help facilities reduce carbon footprints.
ideas.title: EcoGridHamilton
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard data forecasting with clear measurable impact on energy efficiency.
